newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish union wants task force on house prices.
newsitem.headline: Irish union wants task force on house prices.

text.p: Ireland's largest union SIPTU on Thursday warned of the danger of spiralling house prices and said it had written to Finance Minister Charlie McCreevy urging a task force be set up to address the issue.
SIPTU said in a statement that house price increases in some areas have been more than 10 times greater than the increase in consumer prices generally.

"Unless galloping house prices are curbed, very serious social and economic problems will emerge which could undermine much of the progress associated with the "Celtic Tiger" economy," SIPTU's national industrial secretary Des Geraghty said.

He said a task force, representing unions, employers, borrowers and consumers, the relevant industries and government, should be set up to recommend a precise range of measures which would be effective in dealing with the issue.
